title: Resolution Endoclips Vs Epinephrine Injection and Heater Probe
brief_summary: To compare the efficacy of a novel endoscopic clipping device(Resolution Clip™) and conventional epinephrine injection and heater probe thermocoagulation in control of peptic ulcer bleeding and prevention of recurrent bleeding
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>16 , can obtain written consent
* Ulcers that require endoscopic therapy with SRH: Forrest I a, Ib, II a and II b

Exclusion Criteria:

* Moribund patients with terminal malignancy
* Pregnancy
* Intercurrent ulcer complication that prevents treatment and surgery becomes mandatory such as bulbar stenosis and ulcer perforation
